text: {"edits": [{"finding_ids": ["app/metrics.py:14:deprecated-method"], "search": "    value: Union[int, str]", "replace": "    value: Annotated[Union[int, str], Field(union_mode='left_to_right')]", "explanation": "The failing test shows that in Pydantic v2 the default 'smart' union mode keeps the string \"42\" as str, because it is an exact type match for the str member. Pydantic v1 tried members left to right and coerced \"42\" to int, which is the behavior the test expects. Setting union_mode='left_to_right' (Field option in Pydantic v2) restores the v1 ordering, so numeric strings become int and \"n/a\" still falls back to str. Annotated and Field are already imported, so no import change is needed."}], "notes": "The failure is a Union semantics change, not a method rename. Pydantic v2's default smart union mode keeps \"42\" as str, so numeric_total() sums nothing and returns 0. The fix applies union_mode='left_to_right' via Annotated and Field, which were already imported (Annotated was imported but unused before this edit). The previous edit was rejected only because it was out of scope; this edit's search text is the value field line, which is inside the Metric model and near the reported failure. The deprecated-method finding at line 14 is already fixed: parse_csv_row uses model_validate. No edit is needed for it, so it is not repeated. Nothing else changes."}
